configuration.autoRefreshMinutes.descrip: How often to refresh every account automatically, in minutes. 0 turns automatic refresh off.
configuration.language.description: The language used by the extension's views and backend messages. Command names in the Command Palette and the description text of this setting itself always follow VS Code's own display language, so changing this setting does not change those.
configuration.proxy.host.description: The proxy server's host name. Used only when "aiUsageManager.proxy.mode" is "manual".
configuration.proxy.mode.description: How the backend connects to the network. "system" (default) follows the Windows proxy setting and the HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY environment variables. "manual" uses the host and port below. "none" always connects directly.
configuration.proxy.mode.enum.none: Do not use a proxy (connect directly)
configuration.proxy.port.description: The proxy server's port. Used only when "aiUsageManager.proxy.mode" is "manual".
configuration.proxy.username.description: The proxy user name. Leave empty if the proxy needs no sign-in. The password is **not** kept here — `settings.json` is plain text and is copied to your other machines by Settings Sync. Set it with [Set Proxy Password](command:aiUsageManager.setProxyPassword), which stores it encrypted on this machine only.
configuration.pythonPath.description: The Python executable that runs the backend. Leave empty to find one automatically (the interpreter the Python extension has selected → the workspace `.venv` / `venv` → `py -3` / `python3` / `python` on PATH, in that order). Point this at an environment that has `requests` installed.
configuration.refreshOnOpen.description: Refresh everything once when the view is opened.
configuration.showStatusBar.description: Show the account closest to its limit in the status bar.
